description: Source code for a FastAPI-based weather and travel guide service, which includes endpoint definitions, helper functions for geocoding and fetching weather data, and data models for the API responses.

classes.name: DailyForecast
classes.description: Represents a single day's forecast with fields for date, temperature, precipitation probability, and condition.

classes.name: ClothingRecommendation
classes.description: Provides clothing tips for a specific forecast day.

classes.name: PopularPlace
classes.description: Represents a popular place to visit within the city.

classes.name: TravelGuideResponse
classes.description: Response model aggregating city info, forecast, clothing recommendations, and popular places.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Basic health check endpoint that returns a health status message.

methods.name: TravelGuideResponse get_travel_guide(city: str = Query(..., description="City name to search, e.g., 'Paris' or 'New York'"))
methods.description: Main API endpoint that accepts a city name, geocodes it, fetches weather data, generates recommendations, and returns the travel guide.

methods.name: _geocode_city(city: str)
methods.description: Helper function to geocode a city name to coordinates and metadata using Nominatim API.

methods.name: List[DailyForecast] _fetch_5day_forecast(lat: float, lon: float)
methods.description: Helper function to fetch a 5-day weather forecast from Open-Meteo API based on latitude and longitude.
